reasoning: EAP105/2/5/37 confirms this is an archival Bhutanese ms, not a canonical circulating text. No English translation found across Lotsawa House, WorldCat, BDRC, archive.org, Brill, or general web. Only English mo divination translation (Mipham/Goldberg, Snow Lion 2000) is a distinct unrelated work. The Ogyen Choling Collection ms genre (Bhutanese local divination manual) has received negligible translation attention. Absence is well-bounded but BDRC direct catalog and WorldCat were access-limited.
